why.title: Why the market rose today
why.summary: In plain words: the market rose, mainly because: shares rose in other big markets (like the US and Asia), which usually lifts the mood in India too. The news reasons below are matched automatically from headlines, so treat them as what's being reported, not proof.

points.text: The market rose: Sensex +1.3%, Nifty 50 +1.3%, Nifty Smallcap 250 +0.5%, Nifty LargeMidcap 250 +1.3%.
More stocks rose than fell in your funds (175 up, 82 down).
Biggest drag on your money: Healthcare Global Enterprises Ltd (−7.8%), which cost you about ₹2,984 because you hold roughly ₹38,462 of it.
Helping most: HDFC Bank Ltd (+2.2%), adding about ₹8,400 to your money.
Estimated effect on your funds: Axis Small Cap +0.61%, Mirae Asset Large & Midcap +1.17%, JioBlackRock Flexi Cap +1.02%. In total your portfolio moved about +₹91,615 (+0.89%).
Mirae Asset Large & Midcap moved the most. Funds holding more small and mid-sized stocks swing more than funds holding mostly large ones.
Shares rose in other big markets (like the US and Asia), which usually lifts the mood in India too.
